basics.name: Parsa Majidi
basics.label: Embedded Systems Engineer
basics.summary: Embedded Systems Engineer with expertise in Linux/Android BSP bring-up and low-level firmware across embedded Linux and Android platforms. At Kynetics, I work on board enablement, driver integration, and performance tuning, using oscilloscopes/logic analyzers and JTAG to diagnose hardware–software issues. Graduated M.Sc. in ICT (Smart Industry 4.0) with research interests in real-time embedded computing and efficient edge AI. Passionate about building reliable, production-ready systems from schematic to kernel to application.

work.name: Kynetics Inc.
work.summary: C/C++, Android/Linux BSPs, Firmware, Kernel, OTA
highlights: Developed and integrated PD firmware in C for a custom iPad stand, increasing third-party USB-C hub interoperability from 40% to 90%
Ported and maintained Android (AOSP) and Linux BSPs, configuring bootloaders and kernel parameters for custom ARM-based hardware platforms
Debugged device drivers for Ethernet, I2C, CAN, and Bluetooth; resolved low-level hardware–software conflicts using JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers
Ported and configured PipeWire, PulseAudio, and BlueALSA for custom Linux builds; optimized Bluetooth A2DP/HFP profiles for better audio performance
Upstreamed code to the spi-tools project to improve the SPI bus utility for the broader developer community (commit 31c8a46)

projects.name: ImageUploader: USB and SD card image flasher
projects.summary: Cross-platform C tool to flash disk images to USB drives and SD cards and back them up. A modernized fork of USBImager by bzt.
highlights: Redesigned the GTK interface with a header bar, drag and drop, and light/dark theme support
Fixed truncated images being reported as written successfully, plus backup, pax archive, and X11 crash bugs
Set up GitHub Actions builds for Windows and macOS and released v1.0.0 for Windows, macOS, and Linux (deb, GTK, X11)

projects.name: Porting and Developing Android 14 on Verdin iMX8MP
projects.summary: Adapted and optimized Android 14 for the Verdin i.MX 8M Plus module.
highlights: Achieved 70-90% boot-time reduction by enabling and fine-tuning hibernation features
Customized the Linux kernel, optimized bootloader settings, and integrated peripheral support

projects.name: Neural Network Implementation on FPGA Artix-7
projects.summary: Implementation of a Keras neural network using HLS4ML on an Artix-7 FPGA.
highlights: Integrated with a custom VHDL-based UART module for real-time serial communication

projects.name: Programming the TurtleBot for Following a Path
